evaluation.summary: The historical baseline and old replay reproduce the reported failure: all five scheduled turns from 3:00 through 7:00 have no Copilot messages or actions. The candidate sends one guard-facing message at 3:00, but then sends nothing to the guard at the remaining four scheduled wakes. Its four measured actions are internal add_copilot_note calls that explicitly record that no DM was sent. The sole guard-facing message also neither requests a patrol report nor checks on the guard, so the called-out behavior remains.
